In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], a '''[[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' helped defend the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when it was [[Raid on the Jedi Temple (Yinchorri Uprising)|raided]] by the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]]. While the Jedi were successful in repelling the invaders, Jedi Knight [[Tieren Nie-Tan]] was slain. This Jedi was among those mourning his death.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]''</ref>
